blurb.en: The same four-node graph kept as a dictionary of neighbour lists and as a grid of 0s and 1s, converted each way.
blurb.zh: 同一张四个结点的图，一份存成「结点 → 邻居列表」的字典，一份存成 0 与 1 组成的方阵，两种表示来回转换。

en: A graph is a set of nodes and the edges between them. The adjacency list keeps, for every node, a list of the nodes it is joined to - here a dictionary from name to list. The adjacency matrix numbers the nodes 0, 1, 2 and so on, and keeps an n by n grid: the cell in row i, column j is 1 when there is an edge from node i to node j, and 0 otherwise. The list nodes fixes which number belongs to which name, and the index dictionary answers the reverse question.

In an undirected graph every edge appears twice: B is in A's list and A is in B's, and the matrix is symmetric about its diagonal. The demo turns the lists into a matrix and back again and gets the original dictionary, so that comparison prints True.

The two forms make different questions cheap. Whether B and D are joined is one look-up in the matrix but a search through B's list - and the answer is no, both ways. C's degree, the number of its neighbours, is the length of its list or the sum of its row: 3 either way. A matrix always takes n squared cells, even when there are few edges, while the lists only take room for the edges that exist, which is why sparse graphs are usually kept as lists.
Every row of the matrix is built as a list of its own. Writing the grid as one row repeated n times would make all the rows the same list object, and setting one cell would change a whole column.
zh: 图就是一组结点加上它们之间的边。邻接表给每个结点记一张「与它相连的结点」列表——这里是一个从名字到列表的字典。邻接矩阵把结点编号为 0、1、2……，记一个 n 行 n 列的方阵：第 i 行第 j 列那一格为 1，表示有一条从结点 i 到结点 j 的边，否则为 0。列表 nodes 定下哪个编号对应哪个名字，字典 index 回答反过来的问题。
无向图里每条边出现两次：B 在 A 的列表里，A 也在 B 的列表里；矩阵关于对角线对称。演示块把邻接表转成矩阵、再转回来，得到的正是原来的字典，所以那次比较打印 True。
两种表示让不同的问题变得便宜。问 B 与 D 之间有没有边，在矩阵里查一格即可，在邻接表里要翻一遍 B 的列表——两种办法的答案都是没有。C 的度（邻居个数）是它那张列表的长度，也是矩阵里它那一行的和：两种算法都是 3。矩阵总要占 n 的平方个格子，边再少也一样；邻接表只为实际存在的边占地方，所以稀疏的图一般存成邻接表。
矩阵的每一行都各自新建一个列表。如果把同一行重复 n 次拼成方阵，所有行就是同一个列表对象，改一格会改掉整整一列。

lineNotes.en: One new row for every node. The underscore is the usual name for a loop variable that is never used.
lineNotes.zh: 每个结点新建一行。下划线是「用不着的循环变量」的惯用名字。

lineNotes.en: Two dictionaries are equal when they have the same keys with equal values. The order inside each neighbour list does matter, and to_list builds them in the order of nodes.
lineNotes.zh: 两个字典有相同的键、对应的值也相等，就算相等。每张邻居列表里的先后是要比的，而 to_list 按 nodes 的顺序建它们。

run.expect:
A [0, 1, 1, 0]
B [1, 0, 1, 0]
C [1, 1, 0, 1]
D [0, 0, 1, 0]
True

title.zh: 广度优先搜索的访问顺序

blurb.en: Visit a graph ring by ring outwards from a start node: a queue holds the nodes waiting their turn, and a set remembers which ones have already been queued.
blurb.zh: 从起点出发，一圈一圈往外访问整张图：队列里排着等待处理的结点，集合记住哪些结点已经排进过队列。

en: Breadth-first search visits the start, then every node one edge away, then every node two edges away, and so on. A queue produces exactly that order: nodes join at the back and are taken from the front, so everything found at one distance is dealt with before anything found at the next.

deque from the collections module is the queue here because taking from its front is quick, where a plain list would have to shift every remaining item along. What a queue is belongs to the Data Structures module; on this page it is just a container.
A node is marked the moment it joins the queue, not when it leaves. Marking it later would let the same node be queued twice - once by each of two neighbours - and appear twice in the order.

From A the order is A, B, C, D, E, F: A itself, then its neighbours B and C, then the nodes two steps away. Starting from E gives E, B, F, A, D, C. G and H form a separate piece of the graph, so a search from A never reaches them, and a search from G finds only G and H. Every node and every edge is handled once: time O(V + E).
zh: 广度优先搜索先访问起点，再访问离它一条边的全部结点，再访问离它两条边的全部结点，依此类推。队列恰好给出这个顺序：结点从队尾进、从队头出，所以同一距离上找到的结点，全都先于下一距离上找到的结点处理。
这里用 collections 模块的 deque 当队列，因为从它的头部取出很快；普通列表从头部取出，要把后面每一项都往前挪一格。队列本身是什么归「数据结构」模块讲，这一页只把它当容器用。
结点在排进队列的那一刻就做标记，而不是出队时才标。晚一步标记，同一个结点就可能被两个邻居各放进队列一次，在访问顺序里出现两次。
从 A 出发的顺序是 A、B、C、D、E、F：先是 A，再是它的邻居 B 和 C，然后是两步远的结点。从 E 出发得到 E、B、F、A、D、C。G 与 H 是图里另外一块，从 A 出发永远到不了它们，从 G 出发也只找得到 G 和 H。每个结点、每条边都只处理一次：时间 O(V + E)。

lineNotes.en: Neighbours join the queue in the order their list gives, which is why B comes before C.
lineNotes.zh: 邻居按列表里的先后入队，所以 B 排在 C 前面。

title.zh: 用广度优先搜索找最短路

blurb.en: When every edge counts as one step, breadth-first search reaches each node along a shortest route first; remembering where each node was reached from lets you walk the route back.
blurb.zh: 每条边都只算一步时，广度优先搜索第一次到达某个结点走的就是最短的路；记住每个结点是从哪里走来的，就能把这条路倒着走回去。

en: Because breadth-first search works outwards one distance at a time, the first time it reaches a node is along a route with the fewest edges. So it is enough to remember, for each node, which node it was first reached from: its parent.

The parent dictionary does two jobs. Its keys are the nodes already seen, so there is no separate visited set, and its values are the links back. The start's parent is None, which marks where the walk back ends.

When the goal comes off the queue, following parent links from it leads back to the start, collecting nodes goal first; turning that list round gives the path from start to goal. From D to F the path is D, B, E, F - three steps. Asking for A to A gives just A, and asking for A to H gives None: H is in the other piece of the graph, so the queue runs dry without reaching it.
There can be more than one shortest path, and which one comes back depends on the order of the neighbour lists. The time is O(V + E), the same as the plain search.
zh: 广度优先搜索按距离一圈一圈往外走，所以它第一次到达某个结点，走的就是边数最少的路。于是只要为每个结点记住它是从哪个结点第一次走到的——它的父结点——就够了。
parent 字典身兼两职：它的键就是已经见过的结点，所以不用另设 visited 集合；它的值是往回走的链接。起点的父结点是 None，标明往回走到哪里为止。
终点出队时，从它顺着父结点链接往回走就回到起点，一路收集结点、终点在前；把这张列表倒过来，就是从起点到终点的路。从 D 到 F 的路是 D、B、E、F，共三步。问 A 到 A，得到的只有 A；问 A 到 H，得到 None：H 在图的另一块里，队列走空了也没碰到它。
最短的路可能不止一条，交回的是哪一条取决于邻居列表的先后。时间 O(V + E)，与普通的广度优先搜索相同。

lineNotes.en: The start is seen from the outset and has no parent.
lineNotes.zh: 起点一开始就算见过，它没有父结点。

lineNotes.en: A path of four nodes is three edges, so the number of steps is one less than the length.
lineNotes.zh: 四个结点的路只有三条边，所以步数比长度少一。

blurb.en: Follow one branch as far as it leads before trying the next: each call visits a node, then calls itself for every neighbour not yet seen.
blurb.zh: 沿一条岔路走到头，再回头试下一条：每次调用访问一个结点，再对每个还没见过的邻居调用自己。

en: Depth-first search follows one neighbour, then that node's first unseen neighbour, and so on, turning back only when it reaches a node with nothing new next to it. Written recursively, turning back is simply a call returning, after which the loop in the caller moves on to its next neighbour.

The problem splits naturally: visiting everything reachable from a node means visiting the node itself, then everything reachable from each neighbour not yet seen. There is no separate base case - a node whose neighbours have all been seen simply makes no further calls. The mechanics of recursion are on the Recursion page.
dfs_order only starts things off with a fresh set and a fresh list. dfs fills them in and hands the same two objects to every deeper call, so all the calls share one record of what has been seen.

From A the order is A, B, D, E, F, C: from B the search goes to D, backs up, goes to E and on to F, and only reaches C from F. From E it is E, B, A, C, F, D. 'Depth-First Search with a Stack' produces the same orders without recursion. Time O(V + E).
zh: 深度优先搜索先走一个邻居，再走那个结点第一个没见过的邻居，如此一直往深处走，直到某个结点旁边再没有新结点才回头。写成递归，「回头」就是一次调用返回，调用方的循环接着看它的下一个邻居。
这个问题天然分成子问题：访问从某结点出发能到的一切，就是访问这个结点本身，再访问从它每个没见过的邻居出发能到的一切。没有单独写的基例——邻居全都见过的结点不再发起调用，递归自然停下。递归的机制见「递归」一页。
dfs_order 只负责开个头：给一个新集合、一个新列表。dfs 往里面填，并把这同两个对象交给每一层更深的调用，所以所有调用共用同一份「见过谁」的记录。
从 A 出发的顺序是 A、B、D、E、F、C：从 B 走到 D，退回来，再走到 E、接着到 F，最后才从 F 走到 C。从 E 出发是 E、B、A、C、F、D。「深度优先搜索（显式栈）」不用递归，得到的顺序完全相同。时间 O(V + E)。

lineNotes.en: Marked on arrival, before any neighbour is looked at, so a neighbour that leads back here stops at once.
lineNotes.zh: 一到就标记，先于查看任何邻居，所以绕回这里的邻居会立刻停下。

blurb.en: The same depth-first order without recursion: a list used as a stack holds the nodes still to visit, and a node is marked only when it comes off.
blurb.zh: 不用递归得到同样的深度优先顺序：一个当栈用的列表存着还要访问的结点，结点出栈时才做标记。

en: A recursive search keeps its place in the call stack; this version keeps it in a list used as a stack instead - push with append, take from the end with pop. The nodes found most recently are explored first, which is what makes the search depth-first.

Two details make the order match 'Depth-First Search, Recursive' exactly. The neighbours are pushed in reverse, so the first neighbour ends up on top and is explored first. And a node is marked when it is popped, not when it is pushed: the same node can be pushed more than once, and the copy that counts is the one pushed most recently, from deepest in the search. The check after popping throws the stale copies away.

From A the order is A, B, D, E, F, C, and from E it is E, B, A, C, F, D - the same as the recursive version. A chain of nodes far longer than a thousand would make the recursive version hit Python's recursion limit; this one only grows a list. Time O(V + E).
zh: 递归版把「走到哪了」记在调用栈里；这一版改记在一个当栈用的列表里——append 压入，pop 从末尾取出。最近找到的结点最先展开，这正是「深度优先」的由来。
有两个细节让顺序与「深度优先搜索（递归）」完全一致。邻居倒着压栈，第一个邻居就落在栈顶、最先展开。结点在出栈时才标记，而不是压栈时：同一个结点可能被压进去好几次，算数的是最近压进去的那一份——它来自搜索的最深处。出栈后的那个检查把过期的副本丢掉。
从 A 出发的顺序是 A、B、D、E、F、C，从 E 出发是 E、B、A、C、F、D——与递归版相同。一条长度远超一千的结点链会让递归版撞上 Python 的递归上限；这一版只是列表变长。时间 O(V + E)。

lineNotes.en: A node can be on the stack more than once; only the first copy to come off is visited.
lineNotes.zh: 同一个结点可能在栈里不止一份；只有最先出栈的那一份会被访问。

blurb.en: Shortest distances from one node when the edges have weights: again and again, fix the closest node that is not yet final and update its neighbours - the table method from exam answers.
blurb.zh: 边带权重时，求从一个结点出发到各处的最短距离：一轮又一轮，定下还没定的结点里最近的那个，再更新它的邻居——考卷上那张表的做法。

en: Every edge now has a weight, such as a distance in kilometres, and the shortest route is the one with the smallest total weight, not the fewest edges. The graph is a dictionary from each node to a list of (neighbour, weight) pairs; in an undirected graph each edge is listed at both ends.

dist is the table. Every node starts at infinity - float('inf'), which is bigger than any number - except the start, at 0. Each round scans the whole table for the unfinished node with the smallest distance, marks it done, and relaxes its edges: if going through it to a neighbour is shorter than the neighbour's current entry, the entry is replaced.

Once a node is the closest unfinished one, its distance is final: any other route to it would have to leave the finished nodes through a node that is already at least as far away, and weights are never negative. The same argument is why Dijkstra's algorithm goes wrong when some weights are negative.

From A the final distances are A 0, B 3, C 2, D 8, E 10 and F 13 - B is 3 by way of C, not 4 directly. G has no edges, so its entry stays at infinity and prints as inf; once the closest unfinished node is at infinity nothing else can be reached, and the loop stops early. Every round scans every node, so the time is O(V squared).
zh: 现在每条边都带一个权重，比如以公里计的距离；最短的路是总权最小的那条，而不是边数最少的那条。图是一个字典：每个结点对应一张 (邻居, 权) 对的列表；无向图里每条边在两端各列一次。
dist 就是那张表。每个结点一开始都是无穷大——float('inf')，比任何数都大——只有起点是 0。每一轮扫一遍整张表，找出未定结点里距离最小的那个，把它标为已定，再松弛它的边：经它走到某个邻居，若比邻居表上现在的数更短，就改写那一格。
某个结点一旦是未定结点里最近的，它的距离就定了：到它的任何别的路，都得经过一个已经至少同样远的结点离开已定区域，而权重从不为负。同一个道理也说明了：有负权边时 Dijkstra 算法会出错。
从 A 出发，最终距离是 A 0、B 3、C 2、D 8、E 10、F 13——B 经 C 走是 3，比直达的 4 短。G 没有边，它那一格一直是无穷大，打印出来是 inf；一旦未定结点里最近的也是无穷大，剩下的都到不了，循环提前结束。每一轮都扫全部结点，所以时间是 O(V 的平方)。

lineNotes.en: Infinity as a float: every real distance compares smaller than it, and inf plus a weight is still inf.
lineNotes.zh: 浮点数的无穷大：任何真实的距离都比它小，inf 加上一个权重仍是 inf。

lineNotes.en: Only unreachable nodes are left, so there is nothing more to fix.
lineNotes.zh: 剩下的都是到不了的结点，没有什么可以再定了。

run.expect:
A 0
B 3
C 2
D 8
E 10
F 13
G inf

blurb.en: The same distances, but the next closest node comes off a heap instead of out of a scan of the whole table; out-of-date heap entries are simply skipped.
blurb.zh: 同样的最短距离，但下一个最近的结点从堆里弹出来，而不是扫一遍整张表；堆里过期的记录直接跳过。

en: 'Dijkstra by Table Scan' spends a whole scan finding the next closest node. heapq keeps a list arranged so that the smallest item can always be popped quickly; here it is used only as a priority queue. Each item is a (distance, node) tuple, so the smallest distance comes out first.

There is no way to lower the priority of an item already in the heap, so when a node's distance improves a new tuple is pushed and the old one stays behind. When the old one is popped later, its distance is bigger than the table's, and it is skipped. The first time a node comes off with its current distance, that distance is final, for the same reason as in the table version.

The results match the table version: A 0, B 3, C 2, D 8, E 10, F 13, and G stays at inf because nothing ever pushes it. With E edges the heap sees at most about E pushes, so the time is O(E log V) - better than scanning every node each round when the graph is sparse.
zh: 「Dijkstra：逐行扫表」每一轮都要扫一遍整张表来找下一个最近的结点。heapq 把一个列表排成「最小的一项总能很快弹出」的样子；这里只把它当优先队列用。堆里每一项是 (距离, 结点) 元组，所以距离最小的先出来。
没法调低堆里已有那一项的优先级，所以某个结点的距离变短时，就压进一个新元组，旧的那个留在堆里。之后旧的被弹出时，它的距离比表里的大，于是跳过。一个结点第一次带着表里当前的距离出堆时，这个距离就定了，道理与扫表版相同。
结果与扫表版一致：A 0、B 3、C 2、D 8、E 10、F 13；G 从来没被压进堆，所以一直是 inf。有 E 条边时，堆最多约有 E 次压入，时间是 O(E log V)——图稀疏时，比每轮扫全部结点快。

lineNotes.en: A one-item list is already a valid heap.
lineNotes.zh: 只有一项的列表本身就是一个合法的堆。

run.expect:
A 0
B 3

blurb.en: Put tasks in an order where each comes after everything it depends on, by repeatedly taking a task that nothing still waiting points to; a cycle means there is no such order.
blurb.zh: 把任务排成「每个任务都在它依赖的任务之后」的顺序：反复取出一个没有待办任务指向它的任务；有环就不存在这样的顺序。

en: In a directed graph an edge from A to D can mean 'A must happen before D'. A topological order lists every node so that every edge points forwards. The in-degree of a node is the number of edges coming into it: how many things still have to happen first.

Kahn's algorithm starts with the nodes whose in-degree is zero - nothing comes before them. Taking one out and deleting its outgoing edges lowers the in-degrees of the nodes it points to, and any that reach zero become ready too. The edges are never actually deleted; indegree is simply counted down.

Often several nodes are ready at once and any of them would be correct. Always taking the smallest makes the answer unique: for the demo's tasks it is B, C, A, D, E. B and C are both free at the start, while A has to wait for both of them.

If the graph has a cycle, the nodes on it wait for each other forever: none of them ever reaches in-degree zero, the order comes out short, and the function returns None. In the second demo A, B and C form a loop; D, which only leads into it, comes out first and nothing follows. Scanning ready for the smallest costs O(V) a step, so the sort takes O(V squared + E).
zh: 有向图里，一条从 A 指向 D 的边可以表示「A 必须在 D 之前做」。拓扑顺序把所有结点排成一列，使每条边都指向后面。结点的入度是指向它的边数：还有几件事必须先做。
Kahn 算法从入度为零的结点开始——没有什么排在它们前面。取出一个、删掉它发出的边，它指向的结点入度就减一，减到零的也变成可选。边并没有真的删掉，只是把 indegree 往下数。
常常同时有好几个结点可选，选哪个都对。总取最小的，答案就唯一：演示块里那组任务排出来是 B、C、A、D、E。B 和 C 一开始都没有前置，A 要等它们两个都做完。
图里有环时，环上的结点互相等待、永远等不完：它们的入度都减不到零，排出来的顺序缺了一截，函数返回 None。第二个演示里 A、B、C 连成一个环；只指向环的 D 最先出来，之后再没有别的了。每一步扫一遍 ready 挑最小的，是 O(V)；整个排序是 O(V 的平方 + E)。

lineNotes.at: ready = [node for node in graph if indegree[node] == 0]
lineNotes.en: Every node with nothing before it can start at once.
lineNotes.zh: 没有前置的结点一开始就都可选。

lineNotes.en: remove takes out the first item equal to node; the nodes in ready are all different.
lineNotes.zh: remove 删掉第一个等于 node 的项；ready 里的结点各不相同。

blurb.en: Join every node using the lightest possible set of edges by growing a single tree: at each step add the lightest edge that reaches a node not yet in it.
blurb.zh: 用总权最小的一组边把所有结点连起来，办法是只长一棵树：每一步加上通往树外结点的最轻的那条边。

en: A spanning tree of a connected, undirected graph uses some of its edges to join every node with no cycles - exactly n minus 1 edges for n nodes. The minimum spanning tree is the one with the smallest total weight, such as the cheapest set of cables linking every building.

Prim's algorithm starts the tree at one node and puts all of that node's edges on a heap. It repeatedly pops the lightest: if the far end is already in the tree, the edge would make a cycle and is skipped; otherwise the node joins, the weight is added to the total, and the new node's edges go on the heap. heapq is used only as the priority queue here.

The graph comes as an adjacency dictionary - each node mapped to its list of (neighbour, weight) pairs - not as the edge list that 'Minimum Spanning Tree (Kruskal)' takes. The shape follows the method: Prim grows outwards from the nodes already in the tree, so the question it keeps asking is which edges leave this node, and an adjacency dictionary answers that with a single lookup.

For the demo graph the total is 13: the edges B-C 1, A-C 2, D-E 2, E-F 3 and B-D 5. Adding G, which has no edges, makes the graph disconnected; the heap runs out with G still outside the tree, and the function returns None. Time O(E log V).
zh: 连通无向图的生成树，是用它的一部分边把所有结点连起来、且不成环——n 个结点恰好 n − 1 条边。最小生成树是其中总权最小的那一棵，比如把每栋楼都连上网的最便宜的一组线缆。
Prim 算法让树从一个结点开始，把这个结点的边全部放进堆里。然后反复弹出最轻的：若它的另一端已经在树里，这条边会成环，跳过；否则那个结点入树，权重加进总和，新结点的边再放进堆里。这里 heapq 只当优先队列用。
图的给法是邻接字典——每个结点对应一张 (邻居, 权) 列表——而不是「最小生成树（Kruskal 算法）」吃的边列表。形状跟着方法走：Prim 从树里的结点往外长，反复要问的是「这个结点连出去哪些边」，邻接字典查一次就答上来。
演示块那张图的总权是 13：边 B-C 1、A-C 2、D-E 2、E-F 3、B-D 5。加上一条边都没有的 G，图就不连通了；堆用完时 G 仍在树外，函数返回 None。时间 O(E log V)。

lineNotes.en: Any node will do as the root; this takes the first key of the dictionary.
lineNotes.zh: 从哪个结点开始都行；这里取字典的第一个键。

lineNotes.en: Rearranges the list into a heap in place, in one go.
lineNotes.zh: 就地把列表一次性整理成堆。

blurb.en: Take the edges from lightest to heaviest and keep each one unless its two ends are already connected; a tiny union-find structure answers that question.
blurb.zh: 把边从轻到重逐条看，两端还没连通的就留下；「连通了没有」由一个极小的并查集回答。

en: Kruskal's algorithm does not grow one tree. It looks at every edge in order of weight and keeps it unless it would close a cycle, so for a while there are several separate trees that gradually merge into one. The graph comes as a list of nodes and a list of (weight, end, end) edges, not as the adjacency dictionary that 'Minimum Spanning Tree (Prim)' takes. The shape follows the method: Kruskal never asks which edges leave a node - it sorts all the edges by weight once and walks down that single list, and a list of tuples that start with the weight comes out in weight order from one plain sort, with no key needed. The node list is still needed, so that a node with no edges at all is counted.

Whether an edge would close a cycle is the question: are its two ends already in the same tree? Union-find answers it with one dictionary. Every node has a parent, and each group has one root whose parent is itself. find climbs through parents until it reaches the root, and two nodes are in the same group exactly when they reach the same root.

Merging two groups only needs one root to be pointed at the other. That is the whole structure: fuller versions also shorten the paths as they climb, but for a handful of nodes the climbing loop and the one-line merge are enough.

The demo keeps B-C 1, A-C 2, D-E 2, E-F 3 and B-D 5, a total of 13 - the same as 'Minimum Spanning Tree (Prim)'. With an extra node G and no edge to it, only five edges can ever be kept for seven nodes, so the function returns None. Sorting the edges costs the most: O(E log E).
zh: Kruskal 算法不是只长一棵树。它按权重从小到大看每一条边，只要不成环就留下，所以中途会同时有好几棵分开的树，慢慢并成一棵。图的给法是一张结点列表加一张 (权, 端点, 端点) 边列表，而不是「最小生成树（Prim 算法）」吃的邻接字典。形状跟着方法走：Kruskal 从不问「这个结点连出去哪些边」，它只把所有边按权重排一次序、顺着这一张表往下看，而以权重打头的元组，直接排一次序就按权重排好了，不用另给 key。结点列表仍然要单独给：一条边都没有的结点也得算进去。
一条边会不会成环，就是问：它的两端是不是已经在同一棵树里？并查集用一个字典回答这个问题。每个结点有一个父结点，每一组有一个根，根的父结点是它自己。find 顺着父结点往上爬，爬到根为止；两个结点爬到同一个根，就说明它们在同一组。
合并两组，只要把一个根指向另一个根。整个结构就这么多：完整的写法还会在往上爬时把路径压短，但只有几个结点时，一个往上爬的循环加一行合并就够了。
演示块留下 B-C 1、A-C 2、D-E 2、E-F 3、B-D 5，总权 13——与「最小生成树（Prim 算法）」相同。多一个没有边相连的结点 G 时，七个结点最多只能留下五条边，函数返回 None。最费时的是给边排序：O(E log E)。

lineNotes.at: parent = {node: node for node in nodes}
lineNotes.en: At the start every node is a group of its own, and its own root.
lineNotes.zh: 一开始每个结点自成一组，自己就是根。

lineNotes.en: A spanning tree of n nodes has n - 1 edges; fewer means some node was never connected.
lineNotes.zh: n 个结点的生成树有 n − 1 条边；比这少，说明有结点始终没连上。

title.zh: 网格上的 A* 搜索

blurb.en: Find the fewest steps between two cells of a maze by always expanding the cell whose steps so far plus an estimate of the steps still to go is smallest.
blurb.zh: 求迷宫里两格之间的最少步数：每次展开「已走步数加上还要走的估计步数」最小的那一格。

en: The grid is a list of strings in which '#' is a wall and '.' is open; a move is one step up, down, left or right. g is the number of steps taken to reach a cell, and h is an estimate of the steps still needed - here the Manhattan distance, which ignores the walls. A* always expands the cell with the smallest f = g + h.

Breadth-first search would spread out evenly in every direction. Adding h makes A* prefer cells that look closer to the goal, so it usually expands far fewer cells. It still finds a shortest route because the Manhattan distance never overestimates: a cell on a genuinely shorter route can never look worse than the goal does when the goal comes off the heap.

best records the fewest steps found so far to each cell. As in 'Dijkstra with a Priority Queue', an item that comes off the heap with more steps than best already holds is out of date and skipped. heapq is only the priority queue here.

In the demo maze the shortest route from the top-left corner to the top-right corner takes 17 steps - the walls force it down to the bottom rows and back up - and the bottom-left corner is 5 steps away. In the second grid a column of walls cuts off the right-hand side, so the function returns -1.
zh: 网格是一张字符串列表：'#' 是墙，'.' 是空地；每一步向上、下、左、右走一格。g 是走到某格已经用的步数，h 是还要走多少步的估计——这里用曼哈顿距离，不管墙。A* 每次展开 f = g + h 最小的那一格。
广度优先搜索会朝四面八方均匀地铺开。加上 h，A* 会优先看起来离终点更近的格子，通常展开的格子少得多。它找到的仍是最短的路，因为曼哈顿距离从不高估：当终点出堆时，真正更短的路上的格子，看起来绝不会比终点更差。
best 记着目前为止走到每一格的最少步数。与「Dijkstra：优先队列」一样，出堆时步数比 best 里记的多的那一项已经过期，跳过。这里 heapq 只当优先队列用。
演示块的迷宫里，从左上角到右上角最短要 17 步——墙把路逼到最下面几行再绕上来；到左下角是 5 步。第二个网格里一整列墙把右边隔开了，函数返回 -1。

lineNotes.en: The first item: g is 0, so f is just the estimate h.
lineNotes.zh: 第一项：g 是 0，所以 f 就是估计值 h。

lineNotes.en: A better route to this cell was found after this item was pushed.
lineNotes.zh: 这一项压进堆之后，又找到了走到这一格更好的路。
